description: Scalability guide, final validation, and git commit. Write docs/scalability_guide.md. Run manage.py check, makemigrations --check, and test suite. Run frontend build and lint. Write final report. Commit everything.
steps: 1. Write docs/scalability_guide.md with these sections: (a) Database connection management: explain CONN_MAX_AGE=60 already set, note it must be 0 with PgBouncer transaction-pooling mode, explain per-worker connection cost; (b) Gunicorn worker config: recommended formula workers = 2*CPU+1 for I/O-bound Django, sync workers for DB-heavy apps, --timeout 120 --keep-alive 5; (c) Celery concurrency: celery -A config worker -c 4 --queues=default,notifications,reports,maintenance, separate worker processes per queue in production; (d) Redis memory: set maxmemory 256mb maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru in redis.conf or via command arg, separate DB index for channels (db=1) vs cache (db=0); (e) Container resource limits: add mem_limit: 512m, cpus: '1.0' to postgres and redis services in docker-compose.yml; (f) Nginx: upstream gunicorn { server app:8000; keepalive 32; }, proxy_pass, proxy_cache for static assets, gzip on; (g) Known bottlenecks: list from assessment (menu not cached → wired in FEAT-002, N+1 → fixed in FEAT-001); (h) Scaling milestones: 0-10 branches (single node), 10-50 branches (read replica, PgBouncer), 50-200 branches (horizontal Gunicorn + Redis sentinel).

2. Update docker-compose.yml to add resource limits: under postgres service add mem_limit: 512m; under redis service add mem_limit: 256m and append '--maxmemory 200mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru' to the redis-server command args. Add a Celery worker service entry: image same as app, command 'celery -A config worker -l info -c 4 -Q default,notifications,maintenance', depends_on redis and postgres, env_file .env.
3. Run validation: cd backend && python manage.py check --settings=config.settings. Fix any issues found.
4. Run migration check: cd backend && python manage.py makemigrations --check --settings=config.settings. Fix any model changes that are not yet reflected in migrations.
5. Run the full test suite: cd backend && python manage.py test --settings=config.test_settings. All tests must pass. Fix any failures before proceeding.
6. Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build. Fix any TypeScript errors.
7. Run frontend lint: cd frontend && npm run lint. Fix any lint errors (max-warnings 0).

8. Write .agents/tasks/phase22-performance/final_report.md documenting: what was implemented in each FEAT, all files created or modified, test results summary, known remaining items (e.g., Nginx not added to docker-compose as a full service — only documented), and a note that Phase 22 is complete and Phase 23 has not been started.

9. Stage and commit: git -C c:\Users\kindi\OneDrive\Documents\RestaurantFlow-System add . then git -C c:\Users\kindi\OneDrive\Documents\RestaurantFlow-System commit -m 'perf: optimize database caching and application scalability'. Do NOT push.
